UNSAFE_experimentalStyles.description:
Opt-in to the customizable select UI (Chromium 123+).
When true, the component will apply the custom select styles
Defaults to false for native behavior.

align.description: Determines the alignment of the text inside the input.

aria-autocomplete.description:
Indicates the type of autocomplete interaction.
@see {@link https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#aria-autocomplete}

aria-controls.description:
Indicates the element that controls the current element.
@see {@link https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#aria-controls}

aria-describedby.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.
@see {@link https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#aria-describedby}

aria-details.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description.
@see {@link https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#aria-details}

aria-expanded.description:
Indicates whether the element is expanded or collapsed.
@see {@link https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#aria-expanded}

aria-label.description:
Defines a string value that labels the current element.
@see {@link https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#aria-label}

aria-labelledby.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.
@see {@link https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#aria-labelledby}

aria-required.description:
Indicates that user input is required before form submission.
@see {@link https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#aria-required}

autoComplete.description:
Autocomplete behavior for the input (React casing, string values only).
Use standard HTML autocomplete values or "on"/"off".

autoFocus.description: Whether the input should be auto-focused (React casing).

children.description:
If you need to pass in a children. For example, `<options>` inside
`<select>`.

description.description: Further description of the input, can be used for a hint.

error.description: Error message to display. This also highlights the field red.

id.description: The unique identifier for the input element.

inline.description: Adjusts the form field to go inline with content.

inputMode.description: Input mode hint for virtual keyboards.

invalid.description: Highlights the field red to indicate an error.

loading.description: Show a spinner to indicate loading.

name.description: The name attribute for the input element.

placeholder.description:
Text that appears inside the input when empty and floats above the value
as a mini label once the user enters a value.
When showMiniLabel is false, this text only serves as a standard placeholder and
disappears when the user types.

prefix.description: Adds a prefix label and icon with an optional action to the field

required.description: Whether the input is required before form submission.

size.description: Adjusts the interface to either have small or large spacing.

suffix.description: Adds a suffix label and icon with an optional action to the field

value.description:
The content of this attribute represents the value to be submitted with the
form, should this option be selected.

UNSAFE_className.description:
Use at your own risk: Custom classnames for specific elements. This should only be used as a
last resort. Using this may result in unexpected side effects.
More information in the [Customizing components Guide](https://atlantis.getjobber.com/guides/customizing-components).

Additional details: The provided class names are applied to the root `<optgroup>` element.
Only effective when `Select` is used with `UNSAFE_experimentalStyles`.

UNSAFE_style.description:
Use at your own risk: Custom style for specific elements. This should only be used as a
last resort. Using this may result in unexpected side effects.
More information in the [Customizing components Guide](https://atlantis.getjobber.com/guides/customizing-components).

Additional details: Styles are applied directly to the root `<optgroup>` element via
`UNSAFE_style.container`. Only effective when `Select` is used with
`UNSAFE_experimentalStyles`.
